answers.core: though it may or maynot help performance, the main reason why I think this should be in core is because it'll help confusion. Most beginners who elect to use GDExtensions over using C# or GDScript will expect TypedArray<T> to actually return the type of the array, and those who haven't found out that there's 'Object::cast_to<T>()' function will try to cast normally then get confused as to why that doesn't work. Not to mention in a lot of scenarios it's not realistic to use static arrays or normal C arrays as a lot of times they need to be able to shrink and grow (plus in the case of properties they can't really be used to expose a full array to the editor as normal C arrays are not variant types)

title: make TypedArray return the specified type in GDExtension
